fusions.name: Long Loose
fusions.desc: Strings the staff and looses a shaft at a target up to 8 tiles away. It deals 4 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full reach.

fusions.name: Loosed Fan
fusions.desc: Slips the string and looses 4 shafts in a spread out to 6 tiles. Each deals 5 damage and knocks its target back 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Full Draw
fusions.desc: You brace the staff and string it. For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 1.4 times as far.

fusions.name: Bent Back
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, your next spell deals 30% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.
